_comment: Optional per-project overrides for session-backfill. Copy this file to project_map.json (which is git-ignored / personal) and add your own entries. The key is the project slug derived from the Claude Code project folder (~/.claude/projects/<encoded-path>/) — strip any drive letter and take the path segment after the last parent token (code/src/work/repos/dev/...). The key may be the full slug OR just its last '-' segment.
_value-forms: A value is EITHER a plain string (the [[wikilink]] display name; the Sessions/ folder is derived from it) OR an object {wikilink, folder} to set them independently.
_use-object-when: Use the object form to route a project's notes into a SPECIFIC folder — e.g. fold an old project name into its renamed successor's existing folder, split one cwd into its real project, or park non-project cwd sessions in a named bucket.
_note: Keys starting with '_' are ignored, so every example here is inert.
_webapp: matches any slug ending in '-webapp' (last-segment key)
